title: Keep on screen
prompt: The screen runs from (0, 0) to (screen_w, screen_h). Return the rectangle moved the smallest amount needed so it is fully on screen; its size stays the same.
starter:
func solve(r, screen_w, screen_h) -> Rect2:
	return r

tests.name: Off the left edge moves to 0

hints: Clamp x between 0 and screen_w minus the width; same for y with the height.
`var x = clamp(r.position.x, 0, screen_w - r.size.x)` and the same for y.

docs.name: clamp(value, low, high)
docs.what: Returns value, but never lower than low or higher than high.

docs.name: r.position, r.size, r.end
docs.what: The top-left corner, the width and height, and the bottom-right corner, all Vector2.

docs.name: Rect2(x, y, width, height)
docs.what: Makes a rectangle from a top-left corner and a size. Also Rect2(position, size) with two vectors.
